description: 20 high-frequency C1/C2 academic vocabulary flashcards categorized by core IELTS essay and speaking topics.

words.definition: To make a problem, bad situation, or negative condition worse or more intense.
words.example_sentence: Uncontrolled urban sprawl will only exacerbate existing traffic congestion and air pollution in metropolitan areas.

words.definition: A significant reduction in the quantity or number of something, especially natural resources.
words.example_sentence: Overfishing has led to the severe depletion of marine stocks in coastal waters.

words.definition: To make something less harmful, severe, serious, or painful.
words.example_sentence: Investing in renewable energy infrastructure is essential to mitigate the catastrophic impacts of climate change.

words.definition: The variety of plant and animal life in a particular habitat or ecosystem.
words.example_sentence: Deforestation in tropical rainforests poses a severe threat to global biodiversity.

words.definition: A rapid and dramatic increase in the number or amount of something.
words.example_sentence: The proliferation of generative artificial intelligence tools has fundamentally reshaped higher education assessments.

words.definition: The use of largely automatic equipment in a system or operation.
words.example_sentence: Widespread industrial automation has significantly enhanced manufacturing efficiency while triggering workforce restructuring.

words.definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere in daily life.
words.example_sentence: Smartphones have become so ubiquitous that living without digital connectivity is virtually impossible for modern urbanites.

words.definition: The process of becoming outdated or no longer used or useful.
words.example_sentence: Rapid advances in microchip architecture accelerate the planned obsolescence of consumer electronic devices.

words.definition: The process of making things uniform, similar, or identical across regions.
words.example_sentence: Critics argue that international mass media contributes to the cultural homogenization of indigenous traditions.

words.definition: The mutual reliance between two or more groups, nations, or organizations.
words.example_sentence: The pandemic highlighted the profound economic interdependence of global supply chains.

words.definition: Supreme power, authority, or self-governing status of a state.
words.example_sentence: Multinational corporate agreements often raise concerns regarding the erosion of national economic sovereignty.

words.definition: A great difference or noticeable inequality between conditions or groups.
words.example_sentence: Despite global economic growth, the wealth disparity between developed and developing nations continues to widen.

words.definition: The method, strategy, and practice of teaching academic subjects.
words.example_sentence: Modern educators advocate adopting a student-centered pedagogy to foster critical thinking skills.

words.definition: Relating to mental processes of perception, memory, judgment, and reasoning.
words.example_sentence: Early childhood bilingual education has been proven to enhance long-term cognitive flexibility.

words.definition: Believing in or promoting equal rights and opportunities for all individuals.
words.example_sentence: A truly egalitarian public school system ensures equal access to STEM learning resources regardless of household income.

words.definition: The subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college.
words.example_sentence: Integrating practical coding skills into the secondary school curriculum prepares students for future digital job markets.

words.definition: The ability to produce a desired or intended result; effectiveness.
words.example_sentence: Rigorous clinical trials are necessary to verify the safety and efficacy of novel therapeutic drugs.

words.definition: The branch of medicine dealing with the incidence, distribution, and control of diseases.
words.example_sentence: Modern epidemiology relies on big data analytics to trace virus transmission pathways across major international hubs.

words.definition: Characterized by or requiring much sitting and little physical exercise.
words.example_sentence: Adopting a sedentary lifestyle dramatically increases the risk of chronic cardiovascular conditions among office workers.

words.definition: Designed or intended to deter or prevent something, especially disease or illness.
words.example_sentence: Allocating public healthcare budgets toward preventative care reduces long-term hospitalization expenditure.
